title: Real-world MIDI hardening contract

basis.copyrightedMidiPolicy: record SHA-256/evidence only; do not commit third-party MIDI files

parser.role: binary/semantic fact capture, not notation policy

programChanges.effectiveProgram: resolve per channel at event/note onset

classification.unit: note/event using track + channel + effective program
classification.mixedProgramChannel: classify each note by effective program; do not discard retained pitched notes merely because the same channel also carried non-pitched events

pitchBendPolicy.reason: Phase 14 must not silently flatten a real pitched bend into a fixed MIDI note number

rhythm.boundaryQuantization: quantize source onset/end boundaries deterministically to the integer notation grid
rhythm.intervalPolicy: measure-bounded positive interval -> exact supported-duration decomposition
rhythm.compositeDurations: supported using existing decomposition + derived ties

performanceTailNormalization.reason: MIDI duration alone does not prove legato vs independent voice; do not trim musical data before a separately frozen evidence rule

overlap.genuineIndependentOverlap: must remain fail-closed until standards-backed in-accord support is added

polyphony.implementationGate: authoritative BANA in-accord rule-source/conformance extension required before implementation
polyphony.derivedVoiceSeparation: may be deterministic only after the in-accord rule surface is frozen
polyphony.transcriberAddedRests: must follow authoritative in-accord/rest rules; no unmarked invented rests

meter.notationBuilderBoundaryChanges: already accepted when aligned to a measure boundary
meter.implementationGate: extend stateful bridge/encoder input without weakening the existing mid-measure rejection

keySignature.afterTick0: remain fail-closed in this hardening tranche
keySignature.reason: none of the four real-world acceptance files requires a key-change fix; do not enlarge scope without evidence

implementationOrder.name: parser metadata + non-pitched classification + scoped pitch-bend policy
implementationOrder.expectedEffect: oxygene4.mid must progress past its current parser pitch-bend blocker

implementationOrder.name: composite rhythm quantization + tied decomposition
implementationOrder.expectedEffect: representable performance durations stop failing merely because they are not one atomic duration

implementationOrder.name: re-audit remaining real-world blockers
implementationOrder.expectedEffect: measure exact remaining genuine polyphony/meter blockers after H1/H2; no guessing

implementationOrder.name: BANA in-accord rule-source/conformance extension, then genuine polyphony implementation
implementationOrder.expectedEffect: support independent actions without fabricating source parts or voice numbering

implementationOrder.name: measure-boundary meter-change serialization
implementationOrder.expectedEffect: d_HO0606.mid may progress through its 4/4 -> 12/8 source change once prior blockers are resolved

implementationOrder.name: Word/Windows live acceptance against canonical + Iranian + real-world Oxygene fixtures
